plan.title: bug(swarm): finalize-cohort fetches master; fail-closed argv (parent #3547)

narratives.Description: finalize-cohort prints the resolved delivery branch then fetches origin/master for the lifecycle sweep. The CLI also drops unknown flags, so equals-form overrides and --help never behave as operators expect.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#3547 (tracker, child A -- defect 2)

## What to build

`task swarm:finalize-cohort` prints the resolved delivery branch (`main` on this class of repo) and then fetches `origin/master` for the lifecycle-sweep base. The printed delivery path uses `resolveDeliveryBranch()`. The sweep `baseBranch` is a separate knob that still defaults to the literal `"master"` in both the CLI and the library. The CLI always passes its initialized `"master"` into the library, so a library-only default fix changes nothing.

Unknown flags are dropped. `--base-branch=main` (equals form) is ignored; `--dry-run=true` and `--no-commit=1` are dropped and the command runs live. `--help` / `-h` are not recognized.

Do not silently equate sweep-base with delivery proof (#3041). Keep `--base-branch` as the explicit override.

Cite (origin/master): `packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort.ts:448`, `packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort-cli.ts:12`, `:31-71`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CLI and library default sweep `baseBranch` via `resolveDeliveryBranch(projectRoot)`, not the literal `"master"`
- [ ] `--base-branch` (space and equals form) remains the explicit override
- [ ] Unrecognized arguments fail closed using the existing `unrecognized argument:` convention (covers `--dry-run=true`, `--no-commit=1`, `--base-branch=main` if equals form is not handled, and other unknown flags)
- [ ] `--help` / `-h` print usage and exit 0 before `syncBaseBranch` or any git mutation
- [ ] Command output prints the sweep base alongside the delivery branch
- [ ] When `--base-branch` is omitted, sweep base equals the resolved delivery branch. When `--base-branch` is explicit and differs, print both and proceed (override is intentional -- do not refuse)
- [ ] Regression: on a repo whose delivery branch is `main`, a default (no `--base-branch`) run does not `git fetch origin master`
- [ ] All new tests pass
- [ ] `task check` passes

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None -- can start immediately. Highest operational need on this tracker.

## Out of scope

- `scope:complete` delivery-branch resolution (already uses `resolveDeliveryBranch` / #3041)
- Strategy corpus / probe / spec-validate leftover-rename work (children B, C, D)
- Expanding the ritual-state / occupancy footnote from #3547
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on a main default branch, I want finalize-cohort to fetch the resolved delivery branch and reject unknown flags, so that cohort close does not fail on a hardcoded master fallback.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Update the finalize-cohort CLI module and library file so baseBranch defaults via resolveDeliveryBranch(projectRoot) instead of literal master. 2. Parse equals-form flags and fail closed on unrecognized arguments; handle --help/-h before git mutation; print sweep base. 3. Add tests under packages/core/src/swarm that verify a main-delivery repo rejects fetch origin master by default.

narrative.Acceptance: When --base-branch is omitted, finalize-cohort returns the resolved delivery branch as sweep base and rejects git fetch origin master on a main-delivery repo.

When --base-branch=main is passed, the CLI honors it; when --dry-run=true, --no-commit=1, or an unknown flag is passed, the command fails closed with unrecognized argument; when --help or -h is passed, it returns usage and emits no git mutation.
When the command runs, output shows the sweep base alongside the delivery branch; when an explicit --base-branch differs, it still proceeds after it emits both names.
When targeted swarm tests run, they validate default main fetch and argv parse; when task check runs, it returns exit 0; CHANGELOG Unreleased records the fix.
